title: Quick Filipino Morning-Glory-Pak-Bung Dinuguan
description: A sweet and springy twist on traditional Filipino dinuguan made with morning-glory-pak-bung and sous-vide for a quick and low-fat-friendly breakfast fix.

ingredients.name: Patis (Fish Sauce)
ingredients.notes: Filipino fish sauce for added umami flavor

instructions: Bring a large pot of pork broth to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
Add the sliced morning glory-pak bung and cook for 2 minutes, or until slightly tender.
In a blender or food processor, puree the cooked morning glory-pak bung and broth mixture until smooth.
Return the mixture to the pot and add the fish sauce, brown sugar, minced garlic, grated ginger, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened to your liking.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the dinuguan hot, garnished with chopped green onions and toasted garlic if desired.
For an extra rich and velvety texture, transfer the dinuguan to a sous-vide machine and cook at 160°F (71°C) for 30 minutes, or until heated through.
